observations: White gaming console with a matte finish.
Two red and white boxes for 'Wireless Controller' are visible.
A black power cable with a UK-style plug is present.
The console is resting on a stack of cardboard boxes.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The console's model is not visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may be a different model (e.g., PS4 Slim) or a non-functional unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.

risks.risk: The console may be a refurbished or 'white-label' unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the original manufacturer's box or a receipt showing the purchase date.

risks.risk: The console may have internal hardware failure or overheating issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up and running a game without error.

risks.risk: The controllers may be faulty or have dead buttons.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers being used to navigate a menu or play a game.

proof_requests: Photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.
Photo of the original retail box.
Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Video of both controllers being used.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
